datasets.name: AMI Meeting Corpus, manual annotations
datasets.note: The download page lists this archive as version 1.6.2 of 10 April 2017; its README names it release 1.7 of 16 June 2014. The EN and IN meetings are natural, the ES, IS, TS and IB meetings role-played.

datasets.name: NOTSOFAR-1, transcript JSON of the 240825.1 sets
datasets.note: Fetched file by file; the official helper, which needs a Hugging Face token, is not used. Meetings tagged #NaturalMeeting in their metadata are natural, the rest role-played.

datasets.name: AISHELL-4, Mandarin meetings, test set
datasets.note: 5,241,010,904 bytes. Only the TextGrids inside are read. The organisers chose the topics, so the speech is elicited.

datasets.name: Earnings-21, transcripts
datasets.note: The licence covers the transcripts and associated text files; it is not confirmed for the spoken words. The audio and speaker-metadata.csv are not fetched.

datasets.name: Earnings-22, transcripts
datasets.note: The licence covers the transcripts and associated text files; it is not confirmed for the spoken words. The audio is not fetched.

datasets.name: FOMC press conference transcripts
datasets.note: One PDF per press conference. No converter yet: the text needs a PDF extractor, which this repository does not have.

datasets.name: AppTek Call-Center Dialogues, diarization metadata
datasets.note: Only the 14 diarization/*/metadata.jsonl files; the audio is not fetched. The card asks for evaluation and analysis only.

datasets.name: Hyperledger Slack archive, raw export
datasets.note: One archive of the commit; only raw/ is read. A changed archive stops the run. The licence was added by the workspace operator and is not confirmed for the messages.

datasets.name: Archival-worthy Slack conversations
datasets.note: The licence is Zenodo's licence field; it is not confirmed for the message text. Usernames are pseudonymized.

datasets.name: IRC Disentanglement, raw logs
datasets.note: The .raw.txt files of data/train, data/dev and data/test only. The licence is the annotators'; it is not confirmed for the IRC messages.

datasets.name: Trailhead apex-recipes sample data, data-plan.json and its tree files
Fivetran dbt_salesforce integration test seeds
datasets.note: Invented fixtures in a warehouse layout the connector does not read; every cell is checked as text.

datasets.name: ICSI Meeting Corpus, Edinburgh distribution
datasets.version: ICSI_original_transcripts.zip (3,720,243 bytes) and ICSI_core_NXT.zip (19,488,722 bytes) of 2016-07-25
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0, as Edinburgh states it; the grant is not confirmed
datasets.owner_steps: Decide whether to rely on Edinburgh's statement or ask Edinburgh or ICSI to confirm the grant, record both sources, and switch the run on.

datasets.name: ELITR Minuting Corpus 1.0
datasets.owner_steps: Decide whether running these tests locally counts as NonCommercial under the licence, or ask UFAL for permission.

datasets.name: SEC EDGAR earnings-call exhibits with XBRL company facts
datasets.version: a selection of 8-K EX-99.x exhibits, pinned per exhibit
datasets.licence: No licence covers the exhibit text; the filer keeps its copyright
datasets.owner_steps: Supply your own declared User-Agent, which accepts the SEC's fair-access conditions; accept that filer text sits in the cache; and run or approve the one-time selection of exhibits.

datasets.name: Future of Coding / Feeling of Computing Slack export
datasets.owner_steps: Decide whether to cache and test these unlicensed community messages locally, or ask the community's admins or the repository's maintainer first.

datasets.name: Software-related Slack Chats with Disentangled Conversations
datasets.owner_steps: Accept the authors' statement that the data is open for reuse as enough for local, opt-in tests.

datasets.name: CRMArena and CRMArena-Pro local data
datasets.owner_steps: Decide whether these tests are NonCommercial research use, accept the acceptable-use policies the repository names, and allow a first local look at the databases' tables and counts.

datasets.name: Maven Analytics CRM Sales Opportunities
datasets.licence: Public Domain, as a bare label; not confirmed
datasets.owner_steps: Create a Maven account, which accepts Maven's terms, and download the zip once into the cache.

datasets.name: GLEIF LEI Golden Copy delta
datasets.version: one dated delta, pinned with its publish date
datasets.licence: CC0, with the conditions of the LEI Data Terms of Use
datasets.owner_steps: Read and accept the LEI Data Terms of Use and tick the download page's privacy acknowledgement; drop SOLE_PROPRIETOR records before any use.
